rows.abstract: Finances the implementation of Barangay Livelihood support projects ybder the Social Reform Agenda of the National government to be jointly administered by the Department of Interior and Local Governments, the Department of Trade and Industry, and the local government units concerned at the provincial, city/municipal and barangay levels.

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING A SPECIAL FUND FOR AIDS VICTIMS AND REQUIRING THE MANDATORY ESTABLISHMENT OF EXCLUSIVE AIDS WARDS IN PUBLIC AND PRIVATE HOSPITALS
rows.abstract: Appropriates an annual amount of P50 MILLION (P50,000.000.00 ) to serve as a Special AIDS Fund to assist the victims of the dreaded AIDS disease. Mandates all public and private hospitals in the country to establish AIDS wards free of charge
rows.status: Substituted by HB10510

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE EXCAVATION OF HISTORICAL SITES, SHRINES AND OTHER SACRED RELIGIOUS PLACES BY TREASURE HUNTERS
rows.abstract: States that any person who shall be found guilty of making diggings and excavations of the National shrines, historical sites and sacred religious places in search for hidden treasures shall be punished with one (1)-year imprisonment and a fine of not more than P10,000.00.

rows.abstract: "Children's Television Act of 1995" Protects the youth's interests through the provision of television programs that will reflect their needs, concerns and interests and which do not exploit them.
